run_openclip_vqa_inference: run zero-shot image classification using OpenCLIP on HPU with a pre-trained BiomedCLIP model
run_qa_function: run visual question answering inference by computing image-text similarity logits with an OpenCLIP model
postprocess_results: postprocess sorted indices and logits to produce top-K label probabilities for each image
plot_images_with_metadata: plot images with their top-K classification probabilities as metadata using matplotlib
run_openclip_benchmark: benchmark OpenCLIP inference throughput and latency on HPU with configurable warmup and iteration counts
